title: Para Pengkhianat Ureueng Pileh .
intro: Sipanyang seujarah, utusan-utusan ilahi geujak lamkawan umat manusia, dan na padum-padum droe nyang paleng toe ngon awaknyan hana geuturi cahya. Catatan nyoe meuputa-puta bak dua boh jiwa nyang toe jih ngon keunabian jeuet keu ujian awaknyan, dan pusaka awaknyan jeuet keu saboh peulajaran nyang abadi.
clues: Tanyoe udeb bak masa nabi-nabi rayeuk, bahpih meunan mata tanyoe teutap teutop keu keubeunaran nyang awaknyan ba.
Rumoh kamoe peunoh ngon wahyu ilahi, teuma até kamoe ka teuga.
Kamoe meukawen ngon agam-agam nyang geupiléh keu geubri peuingat ubak bansa gobnyan.
Watée teuka huköman, kamoe hana kamoe mita teumpat meusom lam kapai atawa kamoe plueng nibak ujeuen nyang teungoh tutong, sabab kamoe peuhina peuingat-peuingat nyan.
Tanyoe geuseubot lam Al-Quran sibagoe teuladan keu ureueng-ureueng nyang kaphe, geupeuleumah bahwa bah pih hubongan nyang toe ngon sidroe nabi hana geupeuseulamat.
Kamoe na kheueh peurumoh Nuh dan Lut, nyang jikhianat awaknyan dan deungon lagée nyan awaknyan jihuköm.

identity.label: Soe Geutanyoe?
options: Peurumoh Nabi Nuh dan Nabi Lut .
Peurumoh Nabi Ibrahim dan Nabi Ismail .
identity.answer: Peurumoh Nabi Nuh dan Nabi Lut .

trial.label: Peue sidang awaknyan?
options: Awaknyan meukawén ngon nabi teuma hana meuiman .
Awaknyan jigoda lé Iblis mangat jiteubiet nibak rumoh maséng-maséng .
trial.answer: Awaknyan meukawén ngon nabi teuma hana meuiman .

outcome.label: Peue akhe awaknyan?
options: Binasa awaknyan meusajan ngon ureueng kaphé .
Awaknyan ji ubah jeuet keu monyet ngon bui .
outcome.answer: Binasa awaknyan meusajan ngon ureueng kaphé .

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
